summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the DMR radio tracker MVP. 14/14 pytest backend tests passing after one test-assertion fix (parser display names). Frontend E2E flow validated end-to-end: login, dashboard render, one-fix + stream injection, all four raw-hex parser samples decoded, radio-detail modal (icon/color pickers), geofence creation with ENTER alert triggered, admin users nav, sign-out clearing localStorage token.

integration_issues.issue: Occasional 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' console warning on navigation. LIVE indicator ends up green so live pipeline works, but reconnect/backoff logic could be tightened in useLiveData.js.

issues: Missing Description/aria-describedby on Radix DialogContent (a11y warning). Add DialogDescription for screen readers.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add <DialogDescription> to RadioDetailModal to silence Radix a11y warning.
(Optional) Improve WebSocket reconnect handling in useLiveData.js to avoid transient 'closed before established' console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 483 lines - starting to approach split threshold; consider extracting routers (auth/admin/radios/geofences) into modules.
record_packet position-cleanup fetches then deletes by id list; can be simplified using single find_one_and_delete or aggregation; minor perf.
GET /api/geofences uses geofence_engine without None-check (would AttributeError if lifespan failed to init). Consider guard/500 with clear message.
CORS: allow_origins from env with allow_credentials=True and default '*' is technically invalid per spec when credentials are true; not a bug here since ingress handles it, but tighten in prod.
test_credentials: admin@dmrtracker.app / admin123 (seeded from backend/.env). Pending user created per-run with TEST_pending_<uuid>@example.com.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral pending users and TEST_ prefixed geofences; radios/positions are cleaned up in test teardown where possible. A couple of test radios (K7TEST, VE3TAC, NMEA-TEST) remain in DB from previous runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. WebSocket at wss://<host>/api/ws?token=<jwt> works but throws a transient close warning on first attempt - LIVE indicator turns green after connect. UDP HB Master (62031) is not reachable externally in this preview - use /api/inject and /api/inject-raw endpoints for testing (documented in the app's MMDVM Setup card).
rca of the issue: Only assertion tweak needed: /api/status returns human-readable parser names ('Motorola LRRP', 'Hytera RRS', 'NMEA', 'APRS'), test was checking uppercase codes. Fixed by lowercase substring match.
